title: Early Careers Recruiter
description:
Description

At WTW, we help the world's biggest organisations make forward-thinking choices about their people, their investments and the risks they face. Our expertise and advice make them stronger and more successful. We also support them to improve their people's health, skills and financial wellbeing. You'll be part of this impact, right from the start.

The Global Early Careers Team is responsible for the attraction, selection, assessment and engagement of early careers candidates on to our structured insight, apprentice, intern and Graduate programmes. We are driven by our commitment to inspire, engage and nurture the next generation of talent as they set out on their career paths.

The Role

You will be responsible for managing and executing a defined recruitment strategy and driving the effective and timely delivery of early careers recruitment activities for several business areas across multiple locations. The key areas of responsibility include:

Candidate Attraction
- Attending and delivering virtual events as well as events on campus, in schools and WTW offices to a variety of audiences from year 12 and 13 students, to undergraduates and their influencers (careers advisors, teachers, faculty leads and parents/carers) - travel outside of your base location will be required to facilitate this
- Partnering with the Employer Brand team and the business on the creation of assets for use on social media

Candidate Screening / Assessment / Management
- Proactive management of the entire early careers' lifecycle - candidate pipelines, screening of applications, HireVue videos and invitation of high calibre, diverse candidates to assessment centres
- Organisation of assessment centres (agreeing dates, agenda, training assessors, hosting candidate drop-in sessions, briefing the team on TopScore set up etc) with the support of recruitment coordinators
- Leading assessment centre wash ups, extending verbal and written offers to successful candidates, providing feedback to unsuccessful ones
- Collaboration with other teams across the business to ensure that trackers and admin are up to date and accurate in real time so that the candidate experience is seamless, onboarding smooth and operational reporting accurate
- Intern conversions - coaching successful interns through the conversion process and extending offers
- Candidate communications - throughout the lifecycle from first click to first day

Candidate Experience / Engagement
- From first click to first day, the recruiter is responsible for early identification of talent, engaging with and nurturing high calibre candidates - from providing coaching sessions to hosting webinars on the application process and life at WTW - each candidate receives a white glove service aimed at helping them to experience our culture before they even join.
- Assisting with the set up and delivery of two insight programmes; Step up with WTW and Level up with WTW and Day One Induction for all new starters.

Stakeholder Management
- Proactive stakeholder management is key. Establishing yourself as an expert in all things early careers is essential.
- Managing weekly/fortnightly data driven operational meetings with stakeholders to provide clear and accurate information. Ability to craft presentation decks.
- Requesting support throughout the process in a timely manner to ensure that you are able to provide the very best in candidate management and experience.
- Contributing to quarterly review meetings; including new season kick off, mid points and season wash ups.

Team Collaboration
- Team collaboration is key within Early Careers team, but also with the many other teams that support us to be able to deliver an excellent candidate experience.
- Collaboration amongst recruiters in the team to establish the most efficient ways of working, ensuring that the right work is in the right location.
- Fostering positive relationships with colleagues to ensure everyone understands their role and its importance.
- Contributing to global project workstreams with colleagues from across the whole early careers team.

Qualifications

What you'll bring
- Proven track record of full life cycle, high volume early carers recruiting within a fast-paced recruitment environment
- Ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously
- Exceptional stakeholder relationship skills: ability to develop strong relationships quickly and maximise resources effectively to achieve goals
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Data driven approach to recruitment
- Proven success effectively working in a fast paced, high-pressure environment
- Self-sufficient and able to work independently, whilst remaining a team player
- Strong organisational abilities and flexibility to work in a performance driven environment managing multiple deliverables
- Ability to travel to various campuses/school and attend events
- Proficiency in MS Office (Word, PPT, Excel) and ATS experience is a must, exposure to HireVue and ORC are a plus
- Curious and willing to use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools responsibly to improve personal productivity, organisation, research and work quality.

Work Style

We operate a hybrid working environment (i.e. a mixture of working in the office and at home) and empower the team to choose their anchor days, however regular travel to the London office will be required (min one day each week).

What we offer
Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company.

We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle-to-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We're committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email

title: HR & Resourcing Co-ordinator
company: Pure Resourcing Solutions Limited - Agency - Temporary
description:
HR & Resourcing Coordinator
Ipswich
Full-Time, 9-5pm, 6month contract with the possibility of permanent
30,000pa FTE
About the Role
We are seeking a proactive and highly organised HR & Resourcing Coordinator to support the delivery of recruitment, onboarding and HR administration activities across a busy and fast-paced business. Reporting into the HR function, you will play a key role in ensuring a smooth employee and candidate experience while supporting the wider people team with administrative processes, reporting and projects.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous HR administration or recruitment coordination experience who is looking to further develop their career within a supportive and people-focused environment.
Key Responsibilities
Recruitment & Talent Coordination
- Coordinate end-to-end recruitment activities across multiple vacancies.
- Prepare and post job adverts across various platforms.
- Manage interview scheduling, diary coordination and stakeholder communication.
- Liaise with candidates, hiring managers and recruitment partners throughout the hiring process.
- Maintain recruitment records, track key hiring metrics and produce recruitment reports.
- Ensure an excellent candidate experience at every stage of the recruitment process.
- Support shortlisting activities and coordinate interview documentation and assessments.

Onboarding
- Prepare employment contracts, offer letters and onboarding documentation.
- Conduct pre-employment checks, references and right-to-work verification.
- Support new starter administration and payroll information processing.
- Coordinate induction and training schedules with key stakeholders.
- Maintain accurate employee records in line with GDPR requirements.

HR Administration
- Process employee lifecycle changes including starters, movers and leavers.
- Administer probation reviews, benefits administration and absence management records.
- Coordinate DBS checks and employment reference requests.
- Produce regular HR reports and maintain data accuracy within HR systems.
- Support the wider HR team with projects and continuous improvement initiatives.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience within HR administration, recruitment coordination or a similar people-focused role.
- Strong organisational and multitasking skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
- Experience using HR systems and Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
- High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Ability to manage confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
- CIPD Level 3 qualification, or willingness to work towards this, would be advantageous.

Personal Attributes
- Proactive and solutions-focused approach.
- Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
- Resilient and adaptable in a fast-moving environment.
- Collaborative team player with a positive attitude.
- Professional, trustworthy and highly confidential in their approach to work.

What's on Offer
- Opportunity to develop a long-term career within HR and recruitment.
- Exposure to a broad range of HR activities and projects.
- Supportive team environment with ongoing professional development opportunities.
- A role where you can make a genuine impact on the employee and candidate experience.

title: Interim HR Coordinator
description:
Your new company
Hays are partnering with a highly successful, market-leading organisation with a strong reputation for innovation, quality and exceptional customer service within the construction and manufacturing sector. Due to a period of growth and increased demand, they are seeking an experienced HR & Recruitment Coordinator to join their friendly and collaborative HR team on a 6-month basis.
Operating from modern, fully refurbished offices, this organisation is known for investing in its people and creating a supportive, fast-paced working environment where no two days are the same.
Your new role
This is a varied and busy HR and recruitment coordination position, supporting the HR team across the full employee life cycle while taking ownership of recruitment administration and candidate coordination.
Key responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating end-to-end recruitment activities across multiple vacancies
- Managing interviews, diaries and stakeholder schedules
- Liaising with candidates, agencies and hiring managers
- Posting and maintaining job advertisements across various platforms
- Supporting onboarding activities, including contracts, offer letters and pre-employment checks
- Maintaining accurate HR records and employee documentation
- Managing HR inboxes and responding to queries
- Producing reports and recruitment metrics
- Assisting with absence management administration and employee life cycle activities
- Supporting wider HR projects and initiatives as required

This role would suit someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment and enjoys juggling multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
What you'll need to succeedTo be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
- Previous experience within HR Administration, Recruitment Coordination or a similar HR support role
- Excellent organisational and multitasking skills
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
- Confidence working with multiple stakeholders and managing busy workloads
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office packages
- The ability to work with highly confidential information professionally
- A proactive, positive and adaptable approach

We're particularly interested in speaking with dynamic, energetic individuals who enjoy working at pace, can think ahead, and are happy to roll their sleeves up to support a busy team.
What you'll get in return
- Immediate start available
- 6-month temporary assignment or fixed-term contract option
- Full-time hours, Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm
- Modern, fully refurbished office environment
- Free on-site parking
- Subsidised staff canteen
- 750 completion bonus upon successful completion of the full 6-month assignment
- Opportunity to gain experience within a highly respected and successful business
- Hybrid working available after initial training period (first 6 weeks fully office-based, thereafter 1 day working from home per week)

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this opportunity, click 'Apply Now' to submit your CV or contact Hays for a confidential discussion.

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:

Working closely with the Business Manager, you will handle a variety of recruitment administrative tasks, enabling the sales team to focus on building relationships and developing new business. title: Training Administrator
description:
Training & Compliance Coordinator - Beccles
Competitive Salary And Excellent Company Benefits
Full-Time Monday to Friday
Permanent Position
Hales Group are recruiting for a Training & Compliance Coordinator to join a well established manufacturing organisation. This is an excellent opportunity to support a forward thinking business with a strong focus on operational excellence, colleague development and continuous improvement.
As Training & Compliance Coordinator, you will play a vital role in ensuring training activities are well organised, accurately recorded and fully compliant with internal policies and external standards. Working closely with managers and trainers, you will help ensure colleagues have access to the training they need to work safely, efficiently and effectively.
Key Responsibilities:
- Maintain accurate and up to date training records for colleagues.
- Add and update details for new starters, leavers and internal transfers within the training database.
- Perform regular database maintenance to ensure data integrity and compliance.
- Coordinate and administer site wide and company wide training programmes, including scheduling, tracking and completion monitoring.
- Manage online learning systems and external/internal training platforms.
- Retrieve and record safety certificates to support compliance and audit readiness.
- Support onboarding by assigning mandatory and compliance training modules.
- Run monthly meetings with Heads of Department and trainers to review training progress and records.
- Work with department trainers to ensure training manuals, records and skills matrices remain current.
- Research external training providers when specialist requirements arise.
- Use MS Excel and Access to support reporting, data management and system administration.

Essential Skills & Experience:
- Strong administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience working with databases, training systems or learning platforms.
- Confident communicating with colleagues at all levels across multiple departments.
- Organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Comfortable working with data, reporting and compliance documentation.
- A commitment to continuous improvement and supporting a safe, efficient workplace.

Why work for Hales Group?
All of our Consultants are committed and experienced in what they do and have been operating in Lowestoft for many years. We treat candidates as our customers and aim to find the right job solution for you.
